name: vintage-film-soulful-look
image_vibe: Soulful golden-hour nostalgia, hazy vintage film, warm emotional stillness
image_purpose: Create a romantic but natural street portrait with roses and analog film texture.

prompt.project_info: A high-angle top-down cinematic portrait on a brick pathway during golden hour.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with wavy brown hair looking directly up at the camera with a soft soulful expression. She holds a bouquet of deep red roses wrapped in brown craft paper and wears a simple black long-sleeved top with a yellow crossbody bag.
prompt.composition_elements: Top-down high-angle framing, brick pathway, bouquet centered near the subject, yellow bag as a color accent, and background falling softly out of focus.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft hazy golden-hour sunlight filtering through the background, dreamlike glow, warm nostalgic palette, and gentle emotional atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Shallow depth of field, heavy visible film grain, vintage analog color treatment, realistic hair and flower texture, cinematic portrait framing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a high-angle top-down cinematic vintage-film portrait of an original adult woman with wavy brown hair looking directly up at the camera with a soft soulful expression. She holds a bouquet of deep red roses wrapped in brown craft paper and wears a simple black long-sleeved top with a yellow crossbody bag. Set her on a brick pathway during golden hour with soft hazy sunlight filtering through the background, shallow depth of field, heavy film grain, and a warm nostalgic dreamlike color palette.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, transparent clothing, nudity, sexualized pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed

assets.name: source soulful roses reference
assets.usage: Use only for top-down framing, roses, brick path, golden-hour light, and film treatment; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the roses, brick pathway, yellow crossbody bag, black long-sleeved top, top-down gaze, and golden-hour film mood. Keep the subject original adult; background details may vary.

changes: Clarified an original adult subject to remove age ambiguity.
Added standard safety exclusions while preserving the romantic cinematic concept.
